neighbours.label: The additive connective ' also' placed mid-clause right after a subject or auxiliary in expository prose (They also bring, It also requires, have also included); weaker on sibling discourse connectives like ' Otherwise' and ' although'
fire: Rainfall has dropped across the valley this decade. Farmers there also report that wells run dry earlier each summer.
The new antibiotic clears most infections within a week, and doctors say it also lowers the risk of relapse in older patients.
Our grandmother taught us how to bake bread from scratch. She also showed us how to keep a sourdough starter alive through winter.
Solar panels cut household bills over time. They can also raise the resale value of a home in many markets.
The museum restored the old clock tower last spring, and the council has also approved funding for a new visitor centre next door.
I loved the hiking trip, mostly because of the views. We also met a retired couple who had walked the whole coast path.
Chronic stress is linked to poor sleep. It may also weaken the immune system, leaving people more prone to colds.
quiet: Rainfall has dropped across the valley this decade. Farmers there report that wells run dry earlier each summer, and the creeks are thin.
The new antibiotic clears most infections within a week, and doctors say the risk of relapse in older patients is lower than expected.
Our grandmother taught us how to bake bread from scratch. Keeping a sourdough starter alive through winter was the next lesson.
Solar panels cut household bills over time. Many buyers find the resale value of a home rises in certain markets, too.
The museum restored the old clock tower last spring, and the council approved funding for a new visitor centre next door.
I loved the hiking trip, mostly because of the views. Meeting a retired couple who had walked the whole coast path was a highlight.
Chronic stress is linked to poor sleep. Over months it may weaken the immune system, and colds become more frequent.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top examples are mostly ' also' after a subject/auxiliary (113x lift, 11% coverage), with a long tail of other discourse connectives (Otherwise, because, although, 'and' after 'Oh') and sporadic code-comment tokens, so only part of the pole is covered by the word. The census disease-frame hit is probably a frame effect I could not explain from the packet.
